title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany Brazil and the US with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.

Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast.

Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens.

You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people experience the interview process with us.

Check out our Culture page here

About The RoleInformative Video by MatyasHybrid/Remote, with travel in BrazilLanguage Skills: Must: Portuguese, English (fluent)Start Date: asap

We are searching for a seasoned, strategic, commercial, and hands-on COO to lead and shape our go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors and evolve our operational backbone. In this role, you’ll oversee our entire value chain - from mineral inputs and field operations to our internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

This is a rare opportunity to refine product-market fit , identify scalable customer use cases, lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling in one of the world’s most promising carbon removal approaches. On the operational front, you will work closely with our Chief Impact Officer and VP of Operations , who leads the charge on regional management, farmer acquisition, and the logistical execution of rock powder spreading across Brazil. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our VP of Science , ensuring that our field strategy is aligned with our scientific standards, operational goals, and long-term climate impact targets - building a delivery system that is not only efficient, but deeply trusted by our farming partners.

As a core strategic and visionary player, you’ll work cross-functionally to ensure our product offering is differentiated and delivers real agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements. You’ll be responsible for orchestrating our 1-100 scale-up journey : evolving early pilots into robust, repeatable, and high-impact operations at national scale.

We’re at a tipping point of scale, with growing complexity across teams, partners, and international ecosystems. The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , ideally in Brazilian agribusiness , and can bridge execution with innovation

You will report directly to the CEO and be a critical member of our Senior Leadership Team alongside our CFO. You’ll directly lead a large and growing team, including:

  • VP of Operations and all project deployment teams including Supply and Regional Managers
  • Strategic collaboration with our Chief Impact Officer, and commercial partners
  • Close partnership with our VP of Science
  • Collaboration with Carbon, and Technology teams
Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations
  • You’ll help define and scale a novel carbon removal product - taking it from early traction to being a key player in agriculture and mining. This is a 1-100 leadership role, demanding bold strategy, deep market insight, and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil, with scalability in mind.
  • Translate InPlanet’s carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement through operational KPIs, systemisation, and performance data.
Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership
  • You’ll drive go-to-market strategies that bring breakthrough mineral products into entrenched agricultural systems, building the trust and partnerships needed for national adoption. Commercial creativity and strategic grit will be essential.
  • Build strategic partnerships with input suppliers, logistics providers, agricultural service firms, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder - from mine to farm.
  • Ensure operational excellence and compliance with carbon standards, farmer requirements, and regulatory frameworks.
Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment
  • Collaborate with Science, Carbon, and Technology teams to ensure smooth integration of R&D, field trials, and data flows.
  • You’ll bridge science and market, ensuring our product not only works in trials but wins in the real world. Field feedback will shape product evolution and create operational systems that scale with credibility and speed.
  • Support the legal team to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.
Team & Culture Building
  • You’ll build a leadership culture that’s entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable - turning high performers into high-impact owners. Your teams will know not just what to do, but why it matters.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.
You can be a Rock-Star if you haveCore Skills & Experience
  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You’ve scaled something from messy beginnings to market success - ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.
Key Qualities
  • Visionary but pragmatic - able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.
Bonus Points
  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.
  • Strategy and management consultant is also a plus.
Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change
  • Competitive Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner
  • Home Office Budget
  • Hybrid Remote: ideally around Sao Paulo
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity
InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.

The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach.

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer
How To Apply
  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).

Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo.   • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;

  • Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;

Procuramos manter a transparência: nenhuma atividade é restritiva; a lista pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se apliquem ao cargo.

O que você precisar ter:

OInspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • Experiência com metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMI, Agile ou modelos híbridos).

A história do KFC começou em 1930, quando o Coronel Sanders criou a receita secreta que daria origem ao frango mais saboroso do mundo. title: Petrobras abre concurso com 6.412 vagas para nível técnico; confira
description:
Petrobras abre concurso com 6.412 vagas para nível técnico; confira

As inscrições começam às 10h desta quinta-feira (28/12) e vão até às 18h de 31 de janeiro

Redação com Correio Braziliense

A Petrobras publicou, nesta terça-feira (26/12), edital de concurso com 6.412 vagas, sendo 916 imediatas e 5.496 para formação de cadastro de reserva, para diversos cargos de nível técnico. As vagas são para cidades do Sudeste, Sul e Pernambuco. As inscrições começam às 10h desta quinta-feira (28/12) e vão até às 18h de 31 de janeiro. A remuneração inicial mínima é de R$ 5.878,82. Para se inscrever é necessário ter nível médio técnico.

O edital, publicado no Diário Oficial da União, será executado pelo Centro Brasileiro de Pesquisa em Avaliação e Seleção e de Promoção de Eventos (Cebraspe). As provas estão marcadas para 24 de março nas cidades vinculadas a cada um dos polos de trabalho correspondente. A taxa de inscrição custa R$ 62,79 e deverá ser paga até 21 de fevereiro. A isenção da taxa pode ser solicitada até 31 de janeiro.

VAGAS

Locais das vagas

As vagas são para Betim (MG), Cubatão (SP), Duque de Caxias (RJ), Itaboraí (RJ), Macaé (RJ), Mauá (SP), Paulínia (SP), Rio de Janeiro, Santos (SP), São José dos Campos (SP), Vitória, Araucária (PR), Canoas (RS), Ipojuca (PE) ou demais cidades na região Sudeste, Sul e Pernambuco que a Petrobras atue ou venha a ter atuação.

Na JDE Peet's, acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor uma xícara de café ou chá.

title: Senior Product Manager - User Progress
description:
Overview

About Company
JobHire.AI is a vertical AI agent for automated job search. We help thousands of job seekers land interviews faster by finding, tailoring, and applying to jobs on their behalf. We're profitable, growing fast, and now expanding the product to deliver long-term user value beyond job offers alone.

Mission
JobHire.AI is a personal AI agent for continuous professional development and happiness at work.

What You'll Do

As User Progress PM , you\'ll own everything related to the user\'s perceived value and progress — before, during, and even after the job search is complete. Your mission is to help users thrive , whether JobHire.AI directly delivered the job or not.

You\'ll design tools, systems, and feedback loops that increase transparency, trust, retention, and engagement , while building the foundation for long-term support like our AI career coach .

You\'ll work cross-functionally with design, engineering, support, marketing, and leadership to build features that users love to come back to , share with friends , and stay with long-term .

Key Responsibilities
  • Transparency & Value Perception
  • Make AI actions and recruiter feedback visible and tweakable
  • Create a progress dashboard, improve smart inbox, and job queue manager
  • Ensure users feel supported even when results are delayed or come from external platforms (LinkedIn, referrals, etc.)
  • Retention & Engagement
  • Build systems that celebrate user wins and support re-engagement after success
  • Create smart feedback loops that guide users to improve resumes, job preferences and settings, and search quality
  • Turn churn risks into motivation triggers
  • AI-Enhanced Support
  • Lay the foundation for JobHire's AI career coach
  • Build tools that help users reflect, recalibrate, and grow beyond their current role
  • Personalize experience over time with user input, data feedback, and goal tracking
  • Impact & Metrics
  • Own user retention metrics, PMF Score, TrustPilot score, perceived value metrics
  • Understand user churn at a deep level and ship product improvements to solve root causes
Smart Outcomes

In the First 3 Months

  • Ship a transparency layer showing what AI did and what recruiters replied
  • Launch PMF Score survey, and iterate on the top-10% user requests to drive PMF score up
  • Reduce 3-month churn rate by 30% by increasing perceived product value via clear, timely in-product communication and intuitive user experience

In 6 Months

  • Ship the JobHire Progress Dashboard
  • Double amount of cases to celebrate wins (and ask for referrals)
  • Drive a 30% reduction in 3-month churn by introducing additional value propositions, including LinkedIn-based company references and peer-to-peer mentoring

In 12 Months

  • Launch MVP of AI career coach with high retention adoption
  • Increase median user lifecycle to 6+ months, engaging the user in network effects
  • Drive PMF Score above 50% and grow K-factor to 0.7+, with strategy, not tactics
Hiring Process

We keep our hiring process quick and simple:

  • HR Introduction Call
  • Team Interviews
  • Product challenge
  • Reference Check (with three prior managers)
RequirementsYou Might Be a Fit If You...
  • Have 5+ years experience in product management, ideally in B2C SaaS or growth-focused consumer apps
  • Are obsessed with value perception, UX, transparency, and retention
  • Have shipped high-impact features that drove user engagement or habit loops
  • Speak data-language, love design, already built AI/LLM-powered workflows
  • Are energized by messy user problems that don\'t have clean answers — and you like making them simple
  • Are a structured problem solver who cuts through noise, prioritizes what matters most, and ships simple, effective solutions first
  • Take a hypothesis-driven approach to product discovery and delivery, validating ideas quickly and pragmatically
  • Demonstrate extreme ownership over outcomes, not just tasks
Benefits
  • JobHire.AI is mission-driven, fastest-growing, and profitable global company
  • Amazing opportunity to build user experiences that create long-term loyalty, not just transactions, shaping the future of AI HRtech, people\'s careers and lives
  • Brilliant team of the strongest A players from McKinsey, Nexters, Gett, Glovo
  • Remote work - work/life balance
  • Competitive package ($80-120k, based on experience and location)
  • Paid 38 days Off (vacation + local holidays) and sick leave

Aqui, nossas técnicas contam com uma lista de benefícios que fazem toda a diferença no dia a dia (ali embaixo a gente detalha todos eles) e com treinamentos de educação continuada, para aprimorarem suas habilidades e se manterem atualizadas com as melhores práticas. Muito bom, né?

description:
Overview

About Us

Nu was born in 2013 with the mission to fight complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. We are one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.

About the role

At AI Core, we are scaling the impact of our AI initiatives to become the primary driver of Nubank’s most critical decision systems. We are seeking a Lead Machine Learning Engineer (Applied AI Scientist) to lead high-impact research projects that bridge the gap between state-of-the-art AI and production-grade financial systems. You will be responsible for solving complex, ambiguous problems using Deep Learning and Foundation Models, ensuring our architectures are scalable, efficient, and driving measurable business results.

As an Applied AI Scientist (MLE), you’re expected to:

  • Research Execution & Technical Leadership (Complexity & Autonomy)
    • Lead and execute complex applied research initiatives independently, focusing on building and optimizing architectures (e.g., Transformers, GNNs) that can be deployed across critical use cases like Credit, RecSys, GenAI, and real-time inference.
    • Address difficult and ambiguous modeling problems that require coordination across various stakeholders (Data, Infra, Product), delivering innovative solutions with a clear focus on medium-term impact.
    • Bridge the gap between research and production by designing architectures that respect MLOps constraints, ensuring models are optimized for latency, interpretability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Strategic Impact & Collaboration (Impact)
    • Develop and deliver innovative solutions that address project-level challenges, focusing on pushing the latest platform and AI research improvements into downstream production models.
    • Actively participate in cross-functional collaborations , ensuring that research outputs are seamlessly integrated into Nubank's decision-making engines.
    • Establish technical standards within the AI Core team for experimentation, model evaluation, and code quality, inspiring peers to raise their performance.
  • Mentorship & Function Contribution (Function Contribution)
    • Serve as a technical mentor for senior engineers and researchers, providing guidance on deep learning fundamentals, problem formulation, and research methodology.
    • Actively contribute to the function's growth by participating in mandatory activities like hiring (interview panels) and leading internal task forces to improve our ML lifecycle.
    • Contribute to thought leadership by participating in research collaborations or internal papers that align with Nubank’s strategic goals.

What are we looking for?

  • Professional Experience: 5-7+ years in applied AI/ML, with a proven track record of delivering research-driven systems into production environments
  • Technical Mastery:
    • Deep expertise in Deep Learning architectures (Transformers, Multimodal, or GNNs).
    • Strong coding skills in Python and proficiency with frameworks like PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow .
    • Solid understanding of MLOps and the constraints of deploying models at scale.
  • Problem Solving: Sophisticated skills in ML problem formulation and the ability to navigate uncertainty when data is messy or unavailable.
  • Communication: Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical peers and cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring alignment and buy-in.
  • Analytical Capacity: Experience with large-scale experimentation and A/B testing to validate research hypotheses.

Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.

Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com o Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de ESG (Meio Ambiente, Sociais e Governança).

Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: Somos uma das poucas empresas globalmente que auxilia seus clientes na busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

Quem Somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com os dados, inteligência e soluções necessárias para tomar decisões informadas e ajudar as instituições em sua busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. A agência de notícias Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial na área de jornalismo e notícias confiáveis.

Sobre o Papel

Thomson Reuters Information Security Risk Management (ISRM) é uma equipe dinâmica que gerencia riscos de segurança da informação para nossos ativos e sistemas. O Senior Penetration Tester terá um papel importante na implementação e apoio ao programa de Segurança, Operações, Estratégia e Arquitetura, com foco em atividades de pentest interno.

Responsibilities
  • Conduzir testes de penetração em aplicações críticas e infraestrutura para apoiar o programa de gestão de riscos da organização.
  • Definir o escopo e entregar atividades de testes de segurança dentro do prazo e do orçamento, de acordo com requisitos das partes interessadas.
  • Fornecer garantia de qualidade e revisões técnicas de entregáveis, resultados e documentação interna (revisão entre pares).

description:
Engineering Director - Local Cards & Site Lead

Join to apply for the Engineering Director - Local Cards & Site Lead role at PPRO

Engineering Director - Local Cards & Site Lead

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Director - Local Cards & Site Lead role at PPRO

At PPRO, our mission is to simplify access to local payment methods and our vision is to enable the sale of goods and services to anyone in the world using their preferred way to pay. We empower partners such as Ant Group, PayPal and Stripe to access new markets, connect with more customers, and accelerate their growth.

Our strength lies in our diverse global team with 50+ nationalities and 10+ international locations- all united around one goal – to deliver the best possible products and services to our partners and customers. While our company mission is to keep innovating global commerce, our internal mission is to #chooseaction, #beopen, #thinkcustomer, #gofurther and #wintogether

The Purpose:

As Engineering Director for the Card Processing Domain, you will own the end-to-end technical strategy, architecture, and execution of PPRO’s local card-rail portfolio while acting as the Engineering site lead for our São Paulo hub, including supporting teams outside of your domain. Your mission is to deliver a highly available, scheme-compliant card processing enabling PSPs and merchants to sell globally.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Security, Risk & Compliance, and Commercial teams to keep transactions flowing smoothly, safely, and profitably. Blending big-picture vision with hands-on leadership, you’ll mentor engineers, uplift delivery practices, and cultivate a culture of ownership and innovation across ~40 colleagues in Brazil and beyond.

This is your chance to be the “CTO” of a domain inside PPRO building, learning, and shipping alongside talented, diverse teams on two continents.

Mission: Build a world-class local card-processing platform that maximises approval rates, minimises fraud and cost, and gives customers seamless access to local card schemes.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Define and Lead Engineering Strategy:
  • Set technical direction for card rails, ensuring low latency, high resilience, and PCI-DSS compliance.
  • Architect a future-proof, cloud-native platform, event-driven services, and real-time data pipelines.
  • Champion innovation across tokenisation, network-tokens, intelligent retries, and SCA orchestration.
  • Deliver Engineering Excellence:
  • Drive continuous delivery and “DevOps as a practice” where quality and testing is owned by every engineer.
  • Embed observability and automated compliance into the SDLC, shrinking incident MTTR and audit effort.
  • Lead and scale a High-Performing Team.
  • Hire, coach, and retain top talent in Sao Paulo fostering autonomy, mastery, and purpose.
  • Act as mentor and sponsor, helping engineers grow and fulfil their potential.
  • As site lead, nurture local culture and community outreach while aligning with global standards.
  • Drive Operational Excellence:
  • Cut auth latency, uplift issuer approvals, and optimise interchange costs through smart routing and data insights.
  • Own KPIs for uptime, latency, error rates, and cost per transaction; use metrics to guide continuous improvement.
  • Ensure Security & Compliance
  • Work hand-in-glove with Risk, Legal, and Partnerships to meet compliance, security and regulatory and scheme standards.
  • Implement automated risk controls and adaptive fraud-mitigation pipelines.
  • Collaborate with Key Stakeholders:
  • Together with your Product counterpart work with Commercial and Partnerships to unlock new markets and revenue streams.
  • Engage PSPs and strategic merchants to translate real-world pain points into scalable technical solutions.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Proven record leading engineering teams in an API-first, high integrity environment and ideally in a payments environment, or similar regulated space.
  • Comfortable switching from strategic roadmap reviews to deep-dive architecture and sessions when needed.
  • Mastery of cloud-native, microservice architectures (Java, Springboot and AWS).
  • Strong grounding in CI/CD, security best practice, and observability.
  • Data-driven mindset; you make trade-offs explicit and optimise for impact.
  • Influence without authority, aligning your team and other functions on shared outcomes.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, clear, candid communicator across cultures.

Nice To Haves:

  • Understanding of PSP economics, LatAm acquiring nuances, and global compliance drivers would be a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with card scheme integrations, clearing & settlement, disputes, and PCI-DSS would be advantageous

What we offer:

Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.

Learning and Development - We offer a 3,000 BRL annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.

Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including life insurance, health insurance + dental plan and travel insurance.

Meal vouchers - BRL 54/ day - Enjoy a moment of conviviality and a good and balanced meal thanks to your meal vouchers. You will also have the choice between meal allowance, supermarket voucher or both (splitting the total value in two)

Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.

Transportation Voucher - we will cover your costs of commute!

Gym membership - PPRO helps contribute towards the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet

New Value (Deals & Coupon Platform) - Get attractive discounts to restaurants, stores and events

Mental Health Platform - We’ve teamed up with a top well-being platform to provide one-on-one therapy, chat therapy, therapist-led courses, guided meditations, and more.

SESC - private institution that makes available Education, Health, Culture and Recreational programs and events and provides Social Assistance to our employees and their dependents.

title: Régis Moreno desponta como pré-candidato a deputado estadual
description:
Régis Moreno desponta como pré-candidato a deputado estadualVice-prefeito de Castro recebeu convites do deputado Denian Couto e do presidente estadual do PRD, Ricardo Franco, e avalia cenário para 2026

Vice-prefeito Régis Moreno e presidente do PRD, Ricardo Franco. Foto: Reprodução

Castro – A 25ª edição do Agroleite reuniu a elite da produção agropecuária e também serviu de bastidor para articulações políticas mirando as eleições de 2026. Um dos nomes que ganhou destaque no pós-feira foi o do vice-prefeito Régis Moreno (PRD), que desponta como possível pré-candidato a deputado estadual.

As especulações em torno do segundo nome do escalão do Executivo municipal se intensificaram durante o evento, especialmente no dia em que o governador Ratinho Junior visitou o parque de exposições.

O convite oficial para disputar uma vaga na Assembleia Legislativa partiu do presidente estadual do PRD, Ricardo Franco, que também é assessor especial da Casa Civil do Paraná. Além dele, o deputado estadual Denian Couto também manifestou apoio a uma eventual candidatura de Régis.

O presidente do partido destacou o protagonismo do trabalho de Régis. “Tem encantado o nosso partido e o nosso projeto para o futuro, para o ano de 2026, por isso faço o convite para que o Régis esteja a disposição para representar não só Castro, mas o estado do Paraná e uma pré-candidatura estadual e fazer com que Castro e todo o Paraná tenham uma grande pujança, representação na Assembleia Legislativa. Castro hoje é referência, temos um excelente vice-prefeito, uma administração impecável e certamente fará a diferença na vida e qualidade de vida dos paranaenses”, destacou Ricardo.

“Recebi com entusiasmo dois convites de grande relevância para disputar uma vaga de deputado estadual: um do deputado Denian Couto, que defende um projeto para o Paraná que vai além de interesses pessoais, e outro do presidente do meu partido, PRD, Ricardo Franco, da Casa Civil. Este é um momento de diálogo e responsabilidade. Tenho reuniões importantes já agendadas e estou conversando com lideranças políticas e de diferentes setores da sociedade. Também dialogo com minha família, que me apoia em todas as decisões, e quero escutar a população antes de qualquer anúncio oficial. Estou motivado e pronto para encarar esse desafio, sempre colocando em primeiro lugar o futuro de Castro e do Paraná”, afirmou o vice-prefeito.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany, Brazil, and the US, with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York, and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform food production in the tropics.
Our vision is bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils , creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We collaborate with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are growing rapidly.
Our culture combines people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket symbolizes our ambition; the Heart reflects our empathy, integrity, and collective impact.
We are proud of our diverse, inclusive team, mainly based in Brazil, where the real climate impact occurs.
Check out our Culture page here.

Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations
  • Help define and scale a novel carbon removal product from early traction to a key player in agriculture and mining. This leadership role requires bold strategy, deep market insight, and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of ERW deployment operations across Brazil, ensuring scalability.
  • Translate climate and carbon goals into operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement through KPIs, systemization, and data analysis.
Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership
  • Develop go-to-market strategies to introduce mineral products into established agricultural systems, building trust and partnerships for national adoption.
  • Build strategic partnerships with input suppliers, logistics providers, agricultural service firms, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder from mine to farm.
  • Ensure operational excellence and compliance with standards and regulations.
Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment
  • Collaborate with Science, Carbon, and Technology teams to integrate R&D, field trials, and data flows.
  • Bridge science and market to ensure product success in real-world conditions, with feedback shaping product evolution.
  • Support legal teams to maintain integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.
Team & Culture Building
  • Build a leadership culture that is entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable, turning high performers into impactful owners.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams in Brazil and globally.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.
Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we aim to solve climate change, and seek individuals passionate about making a positive impact. Trust guides us, drive fuels us, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : Foster kindness and transparency for trust and collaboration.
  • Drive : Take action with urgency and a hands-on attitude.
  • Impact : Dream big and commit to meaningful change in climate solutions.
You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years in senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil, especially in high-growth or startup environments.
  • Experience scaling ventures from early stages to market success, ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO.
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and build scalable systems.
  • Strong communication skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary yet pragmatic—balancing long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • Emotionally intelligent leader who listens, acts, and delegates effectively.
  • Comfortable with complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, willing to get involved when needed.
  • Passionate about sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact sectors like climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining networks.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil.
  • Experience scaling tech solutions for agriculture.
Benefits
  • Competitive compensation, with transparent discussions early on.
  • Share options to foster ownership.
  • Home office budget and hybrid remote work near São Paulo.
  • Personal development budget and language allowance.

  • Autonomy to make a difference and belong to a visionary mission.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil.

About the Role

Informative Video by Matyas

Hybrid role with travel in Brazil

Location: São Paulo or surrounding regions, Brazil

Languages: Fluent Portuguese and English

Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We seek a strategic, commercial, hands-on COO to lead our go-to-market strategy for mineral-based carbon removal in agriculture and mining. You will oversee the entire value chain, from inputs to operations to science and technology, driving scale and impact.
This role involves refining product-market fit, leading deployment, and ensuring scientific and operational integrity, working closely with senior leaders. You will report to the CEO and lead a growing team including the Head of Operations, regional managers, and cross-functional partners.
You will align science, fieldwork, and operations to stay ahead in the climate and carbon removal landscape.

Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.

Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.

Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.

As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a general track for Senior+ (Senior/Staff/Principal) Engineers in any team at Canonical. After the first round of interviews we will establish which teams might be an excellent fit, and progress your application with them.

At Canonical a Senior+ Engineer is not only an outstanding software architect and coder, they also demonstrate the leadership qualities needed to rally a team or department to ship outstanding products. A Senior+ Engineer partners with other Engineering leaders (Managers, Directors, VPs) to take joint responsibility for outcomes at team, department and company level. We hire based on academic results and proven execution, and we select those with a passion for open-source software, innovation, and cutting-edge technology. In this role, you will make a significant contribution in Canonical's portfolio through high-quality code, technical leadership, team motivation and direction, exceptional design, and crisp documentation.

As a Senior+ Engineer you'll drive the architecture, design and evolution of high-impact open source software. Our teams work at every level of the stack. From the kernel and system software at the core of Ubuntu through to major language runtimes and the bleeding-edge of cloud automation and distributed systems, you'll have the opportunity to work on complex but highly rewarding projects. Our teams also build the services which deliver Ubuntu to the world, on cloud, devices, servers and PCs.

Additionally, this role will give you the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and ensure seamless software operations at scale.

Location: we have remote opportunities for Senior Engineers in every time zone.

The role entails

  • Leading design and architecture of an impactful open source project
  • Coding in Golang, Rust, Python, C/C++ or Typescript / React
  • Collaborating proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Mentoring, developing and advising colleagues in their career progression
  • Displaying technical leadership in Canonical and our communities
  • Debugging issues and producing high-quality code to fix them
  • Contributing to technical documentation with the aim to make it the best of its kind
  • Working from home with global travel twice annually for company events

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Technical leadership as well as team motivation, direction and pace
  • Deep experience with at least one of Go, Rust, Python or C
  • Conscientiousness and detail orientation, with a focus on performance
  • Excellent communication skills including professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

Depending on your eventual team, you might also bring experience with

  • Container technologies such as LXD, Docker and Kubernetes
  • Highly concurrent, distributed systems
  • Performance engineering – from kernel to web – benchmarks, optimization
  • Software security – fuzzing, tabletop threat models, analysis, audit
  • Build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Public clouds or OpenStack
  • Debian/Ubuntu packaging
  • Systems programming or scalable web services
  • Deep quality and test engineering
  • Web or Flutter front-end experience
  • REST and gRPC API experience
  • SQL and NoSQL data store expertise

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit globally and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Information Security Engineer
description:
4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Array Technologies, Inc. is a global leader in solar energy solutions – and we have been for over 30 years! Our dramatic growth is creating incredible opportunities on our dynamic, innovative and

creative team. Are you self-motivated, highly-skilled and possess previous Cyber Security / Information Security experience?

Would you love to play a key role in advancing the clean energy revolution? Join the company that is leading the way!

What you’ll do:

The engineer will be a key member in maturing the IT and OT Security organization. They will be part of a global security team that provides support for all areas of Information Security. A successful candidate will have experience with and/or strong interest in becoming a subject matter expert in multiple Security disciplines. These include Zero Trust Architecture, Application and Cloud Security, IAM and/or Data Protection/DLP. Additionally, the engineer will be a point of escalation for investigating and remediating potential threats. The engineer will continuously be apprised of emerging technologies, threats, attacks, and countermeasures and recommend enhancements based on industry best practices. You will:

  • Design, document, test, maintain, and provide issue resolution recommendations for security solutions related to Zero Trust tools, secure software development, cloud, access, authentication/directory services, email, and/or endpoint security.
  • Work with various departments to design, implementation, and maintain IAM policy.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of Zero Trust Architecture and SASE tools.
  • Partner with Dev teams to define, execute, and continuously improve our secure software development processes.
  • Partner with IT and Product teams to assess, document and develop Cloud Security best practices.
  • Participates in security incident response activities, conducts technical investigation of security-related incidents and conducts post-incident digital forensics to identify causes and recommend future mitigation strategies.
  • Identifies security vulnerabilities/issues, performs risk assessments, and evaluates remediation alternatives.
  • Contributes to the development and maintenance of information security architecture.
  • Collaborates with other IT teams such as infrastructure and application development in the protection of the company’s IT assets including network, servers, applications, and 3rd party service providers.
  • Contributes to the development of ongoing information security policies and procedures, and ensures such policies and procedures are put into practice in the day-to-day operations of the company’s technology environment.

The qualifications you must have:

  • Some Experience with IAM, SASE, SSDLC, SIEM/SOAR, EDR, EPP
  • Knowledge of Cybersecurity architectures and methodologies (OWASP, Github Advanced Security, Azure DevOps, Zero Trust, NIST, Defense in depth, Kill-Chain, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Secure Cloud Architecture, Vulnerability Management, and Incident Response
  • Familiar with Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Protection, and Disaster Recovery
  • Familiar with network/security (IDS/IPS, firewalls, DNS, DHCP)
  • Technical knowledge of Microsoft and Linux

Our preferred qualifications:

  • Cyber Security certifications.
  • 5-10 years of IT industry experience with 3-5 years of those in a role directly related to information security and IT compliance disciplines such as app security, cloud security, IAM, DLP, SASE, etc.
  • Strong subject matter expertise in one or more of technical disciplines such as IT infrastructure, applications development and/or information security.
  • Familiarity with information security disciplines such as privacy protection and data loss prevention.
  • Strong experience in managing cybersecurity incidents and event response.
  • Awareness of industry standards such as ISO, NIST as they relate to information security and protection of privacy.
  • Experience with NERC-CIP standard and polices a plus.
  • Experienced in executing privacy compliance initiatives in response to global privacy regulations such as GDPR and LGPD would be an asset.
  • Knowledge of national and international regulatory compliances and frameworks such as ISO, NIST, and SOX.

Array Technologies, Inc. offers equal employment opportunity without regard to race, color, gender, age, creed, sex, religion, national origin, disability (physical or mental), marital status, citizenship, ancestry, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, or any other legally protected status.

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou o que somos hoje.

title: Partner Development Representative
description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

As a Partner Development Representative (PDR I), you will identify and accelerate growth opportunities across a designated segment of our Docusign partner ecosystem. You’ll execute targeted outbound campaigns, qualify event- and marketing-generated leads, and surface high‑value accounts to foster new and expanded partnerships. Success in this role requires consistent, high‑quality activity, strong cross‑functional collaboration, and disciplined pipeline management.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, Partner Development.

Responsibility

  • Partner with direct sales (AEs/AMs) to create and progress qualified pipeline from partner-sourced and partner-influenced leads
  • Develop and maintain strong, professional relationships with referral partners to drive consistent lead flow and co-selling motion
  • Engage referral partners’ customers to generate bottom‑up interest in Docusign, uncovering needs and setting qualified meetings
  • Analyze integration and web usage data to align customers to the right plans and identify expansion triggers
  • Maintain a book of referral partners; run regular pipeline reviews, align on targets, and ensure timely follow‑up and SLA adherence
  • Plan and execute quarterly account planning and enablement sessions with Business Development and key referral partners (in-person or virtual)
  • Use Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to research accounts, identify key contacts, sequence outreach, and track outcomes
  • Maintain daily call targets (plus emails/social touches) and achieve monthly and quarterly pipeline and meeting goals
Job Designation

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position’s job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 1+ year of relevant experience in sales, business development, or partner development
  • Proficiency in English required (supporting the North American region)

Preferred

  • 1+ year in a quota-carrying inside sales or SDR/BDR role (SaaS preferred), including prospecting, forecasting, and closing or setting net‑new meetings
  • Experience selling with or through partners (e.g., referral, reseller, ISV, Hyperscalers)
  • Proficiency with Salesforce (CRM), Outreach (sequencing), and LinkedIn (research/prospecting)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
  • Strong problem‑solving, attention to detail, and demonstrated technical acumen
  • Ability to prioritize, manage a high‑volume pipeline, and collaborate across sales, marketing, and partner teams
Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Sobre a BMP

Somos um Hub de novos modelos de negócios que constrói produtos financeiros e bancários aliados à inovação. Nossas soluções proprietárias e de alta infraestrutura tecnológica atendem a necessidade de cada parceiro de maneira simples, eficiente e segura.

Nossa marca está no centro da revolução financeira, afinal, somos referência em Credit as a Service e o BAAS (Banking As a Service) número 1 do Brasil , com o propósito de transformar o mercado financeiro e construir, junto com os nossos parceiros, o Banco do Futuro.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Liderar a estratégia e governança de Crédito PJ, realizando análises completas de contrapartes corporativas: demonstrações financeiras, fluxo de caixa, indicadores, liquidez, estrutura de capital e capacidade de pagamento;
  • Liderar a frente de Crédito PF (Varejo): políticas de concessão, segmentação, score, precificação por risco e performance de carteiras;
  • Supervisionar portfólios de crédito e recebíveis (PF e PJ): risco sacado, pulverização, aging, vintage, LGD, inadimplência e retorno ajustado ao risco;
  • Estruturar e analisar operações de crédito estruturado e funding (FIDC, securitização, overcollateral, subordinação, garantias e excess spread);
  • Coordenar valuation de empresas, ativos e carteiras (DCF, múltiplos, stress tests e análises de sensibilidade);
  • Elaborar e validar pareceres executivos de crédito, garantindo clareza e assertividade para Comitês;
  • Assegurar conformidade jurídica, operacional e regulatória em todas as operações;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com Negócios, Estruturação, Riscos, Jurídico, Cobrança e Produtos;
  • Implantar frameworks de monitoramento contínuo, indicadores e early warnings;
  • Liderar a evolução de políticas, processos e modelos de crédito para garantir escalabilidade, eficiência e governança.
Perfeil Ideal
  • Experiência sólida em liderança de Crédito PJ e PF em instituições financeiras, fintechs, assets, FIDCs, securitizadoras ou bancos;
  • Forte domínio técnico em análise financeira, avaliação de risco, estruturação de crédito e securitização;
  • Vivência em crédito varejo com visão completa de ciclo (políticas, score, concessão, monitoramento e cobrança);
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes de alta responsabilidade e defender recomendações em Comitês Executivos;
  • Excelência na produção de materiais executivos, pareceres, apresentações e análises estratégicas;
  • Perfil hands-on, analítico, estruturado e com forte visão de risco & retorno.

Gerente de Lançamento de Produtos – Atrium Educação (Uberaba, Minas Gerais)

Descrição da vaga

Gerente de Projetos de Lançamentos Digitais (Launch Operations). Cargo de tempo integral, com presença em Londrina/PR ou híbrido em São Paulo/SP.

Descrição do cargo

Responsável por garantir excelência operacional, previsibilidade, organização e integração entre marketing, vendas, produto, conteúdo e customer success. Planejar, organizar, coordenar e acompanhar os projetos de lançamentos, assegurando cumprimento de cronogramas, entregas, alinhamento entre equipes e execução do plano definido pela liderança.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e estruturar o cronograma completo de cada lançamento, desde a concepção até o pós‑lançamento.
  • Ser ponto focal de integração entre marketing, vendas, conteúdo, produto e CS.
  • Conduzir rituais semanais de acompanhamento dos projetos de lançamento.
  • Garantir cumprimento de prazos, entregas e dependências entre áreas.
  • Organizar e manter checklists operacionais de lançamentos.
  • Coordenar entregas de páginas, e‑mails, materiais, automações, vídeos, aulas, comunicações e fluxos internos.
  • Acompanhar a execução operacional de campanhas, eventos online e presenciais ligados aos lançamentos.
  • Mapear riscos, gargalos e travas operacionais e atuar proativamente para destravá‑los.
  • Organizar o pós‑lançamento (retrospectiva, aprendizados, documentação e melhoria contínua dos processos).
  • Consolidar informações operacionais para a liderança (status, riscos, pendências e marcos de entrega).

Importante

Não responsável por definir estratégia de marketing, promessa de produto, posicionamento ou copy. Foco principal na execução, coordenação, ritmo e previsibilidade operacional.

Qualificações

Gestão de projetos

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança e coordenação de projetos complexos.
  • Domínio de controle de cronogramas, dependências, entregas e acompanhamento de status.
  • Forte capacidade de organização, priorização e acompanhamento simultâneo de múltiplos projetos.
  • Alto nível de atenção a detalhes e capacidade de estruturar processos.

Experiência em lançamentos e produtos digitais

  • Experiência comprovada em operação de lançamentos de cursos online, mentorias, imersões presenciais, produtos low ticket e produtos perpétuos.
  • Vivência com funis de marketing e vendas (captura, aquecimento, oferta, fechamento e pós‑venda).

Competências técnicas desejadas

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp, Monday, Asana, Trello ou similares).
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de e‑mail marketing, páginas de vendas, CRM e automações.
  • Capacidade de leitura de indicadores básicos de funil (leads, conversão, comparecimento, vendas, follow‑up).

Perfil comportamental esperado

  • Forte senso de dono.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de cobrança profissional.
  • Postura colaborativa, sem necessidade de hierarquia formal.
  • Maturidade emocional para lidar com pressão, prazos e múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Organização, disciplina e constância.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia e responsabilidade.

Indicadores de sucesso do cargo (KPIs)

  • Cumprimento de prazos de entregas de lançamentos.
  • Redução de retrabalho operacional.
  • Redução de atrasos entre áreas.
  • Clareza e previsibilidade dos cronogramas.
  • Qualidade da execução dos rituais de acompanhamento.
  • Documentação e evolução contínua dos processos de lançamentos.

Modelo de trabalho

  • Presencial em Londrina/PR ou híbrido em São Paulo/SP.
  • Regime de tempo integral e dedicação exclusiva.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar como Supervisor Operacional na gestão de equipes de campo que executam serviços em área. Será responsável por coordenar, acompanhar e orientar os técnicos, garantindo o cumprimento dos padrões de segurança, qualidade e produtividade, bem como o correto andamento das atividades operacionais no dia a dia.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Realizar a gestão de pessoas da equipe acompanhando as atividades, alinhando expectativas, realizando feedbacks, treinamentos, aprovando e ajustando espelhos de ponto, avaliando desempenho entre outras atividades garantindo o desenvolvimento da equipe bem como o atingimento dos objetivos organizacionais;

  • Conduzir reuniões internas de forma organizada e objetiva, visando resultados;

  • Controlar escalas de trabalho e garantir atendimento a demanda prevista realizando as adaptações necessárias;

  • Realizar configuração de roteadores e modens;
  • Zelar pela organização, limpeza e segurança na área em que trabalha;
  • Executar outras atividades de mesma natureza, nível de complexidade e responsabilidade.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino superior completo ou em curso em Engenharia, Administração ou cursos correlatados;
  • Curso técnico em eletrotécnica;
  • Ter experiência com supervisão de equipes de Telecomunicações (FTTH);

  • Pacote office intermediário;

  • Vale refeição ou alimentação;
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Descontos em farmácias e lojas parceiras.

Horário de Trabalho: comercial, de segunda a sábado.

PRESENÇA ESTRATÉGICA | QUALIDADE | INOVAÇÃO

Há 50 anos, a Telemont contribui para o desenvolvimento do Brasil, com atuação nos segmentos de telecomunicações e energia. Estamos presentes em 10 estados e no Distrito Federal, oferecendo serviços em comunicação de voz, banda larga e dados, transporte multimídia e gestão de sistemas de energia.

Nossa gente

Contamos com profissionais que traduzem em ações os nossos valores, assegurando excelência operacional e qualidade em cada atendimento.

Nossa forma de crescer

O espírito de superação e a busca por novas oportunidades fazem da Telemont uma empresa em que cada pessoa pode se desenvolver e construir uma carreira sólida. Juntos, colaboradores e organização escrevem uma trajetória de crescimento, sustentada por valores que orientam todas as nossas ações.

Nossos valores
  • Operar de modo seguro
  • Satisfação do cliente
  • Resultados sustentáveis
  • Excelência em gente
  • Respeito e simplicidade
  • Colaboração

title: Head of Product, Brasil
description:
Location: São Paulo, Brasil

Type of contract: Full time

About Luzia

Luzia is LATAM’s fastest-growing consumer AI company, backed by world-class investors including Khosla Ventures, A*, Monashees, Prosus and Sequoia. Our mission is to redefine what conversational AI can do by leveraging cutting-edge large language models (LLMs) and advanced alignment techniques to create intuitive, human-like digital assistants.

Just two years after launch, Luzia is already woven into the daily lives of millions of Brazilians. We’re now deepening our roots here at home, bringing even more local flavor and warmth to everything we build. Join us and help shape Luzia’s voice and product for Brazil from day one.

The Role

As our Head of Product, you will lead our core app product initiatives locally driving them from zero to one. You’ll work cross-functionally to define and execute on the product roadmap with a focus on growth, retention, and user experience — positioning Luzia as the world’s most loved AI-powered personal assistant.

What You’ll Do
  • Lead team to define the future of Luzia’s product in Brasil and globally.
  • Lead the local strategy, development, and optimization of Luzia’s product with a focus on user growth, retention, and social features.
  • Work closely with engineering and technical leadership to deeply understand and translate technical possibilities and limitations into bold, forward-looking product decisions.
  • Define and drive the product roadmap based on user insights, behavioral data, and business priorities.
  • Guide Engineering, Marketing, and Design teams with local insights to deliver high-quality products quickly and iteratively.
  • Translate business needs into clear product requirements, documentation, and scopes for engineering teams.
  • Communicate product vision and updates clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop and track key product metrics to evaluate performance, inform decisions, and guide future development.
  • Design and run experiments to test hypotheses, gather insights, and drive product improvements.
  • Operate with agility in a fast-paced environment, embracing ambiguity and driving creative, scalable solutions.
  • Stay on the pulse of AI research and Gen-AI trends, spotting opportunities to infuse Luzia with fresh capabilities.
What We’re Looking For
  • Someone who’s deeply curious about users, passionate about discovering user needs, and can bring bold ideas to life.
  • Deep experience in consumer-facing mobile app development, ideally in high-growth or startup environments.
  • Strong product instincts and a proven ability to make data-informed decisions. Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.
  • Leadership experience in building and scaling cross-functional product teams.
  • A track record of delivering impactful products in internet- or mobile-first companies.
  • Experience with B2C apps, ideally in messaging, productivity, or AI.
  • Comfort navigating technical conversations with Engineering and AI teams.
  • Strong UX and design sensibilities, with an eye for detail and a passion for intuitive interfaces.
  • Proficiency in product analytics, experimentation, and business intelligence tools.
  • Fluency in English is required; Spanish is a plus.
Why Join Luzia?

At Luzia, you’ll help shape one of the most exciting consumer AI products in the world. We move fast, stay humble, and keep users at the center of everything we do. If you're passionate about AI, thrive in dynamic environments, and want your work to impact millions of people, we’d love to meet you.

Our Culture & Values

We’re builders at heart — driven by data, experimentation, and velocity. Our team lives by a “ship, learn, iterate” mentality, constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. At Luzia, autonomy meets accountability in an environment where ideas win and learning never stops.

Your Impact

In this role, you won’t just be building a product — you’ll be helping define a category. The work you do will shape how millions of people interact with AI every day, and help chart Luzia’s course in one of our most important markets.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos buscando profissionais qualificados para se unir ao Grupo CEV, um líder em educação com 20 anos de sucesso. Valorizamos candidatos que compartilhem nossos princípios de excelência, respeito e inovação. Se você tem novas ideias e habilidades para contribuir, queremos conhecê-lo. Junte-se a nós e ajude a moldar o futuro em um ambiente de crescimento e sucesso.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Criar e gerenciar escalas de trabalho e rotinas de limpeza diárias, semanais, mensais e anuais para a equipe.
  • Designar áreas específicas e tarefas de limpeza para cada membro da equipe, considerando a demanda e a especialização.
  • Orientar a equipe sobre as atividades a serem realizadas, prioridades e padrões de qualidade esperados.
  • Acompanhar o trabalho dos colaboradores, oferecendo feedback construtivo e identificando necessidades de aprimoramento.
  • Realizar vistorias regulares para garantir que os padrões de limpeza e higiene estejam sendo cumpridos em todas as áreas.
  • Monitorar o nível de produtos de limpeza, materiais descartáveis e equipamentos, solicitando a reposição quando necessário.
  • Garantir que máquinas e ferramentas de limpeza estejam em bom estado de funcionamento, providenciando reparos ou substituições.
  • Supervisionar a equipe de manutenção em suas demandas diárias.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico à equipe de manutenção.
  • Planejar as manutenções de acordo com a programação das atividades educacionais.
  • Acompanhar o cumprimento dos planos de manutenção preventiva e corretiva para garantir o bom funcionamento do negócio.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino superior concluído em administração, recursos humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência na área e 01 ano de experiência com liderança de pessoas e/ou projetos.
  • Conhecimento em Manutenção preventiva e corretiva.
  • Conhecimento em Excel, Word e PowerPoint básicos.
  • Comprometimento e proatividade.
Informações adicionais Horário

Segunda á sexta: 08h às 18h

Sábado: 08h às 12h.

Sobre nós

O Grupo CEV é, primeiramente, um grupo formado por pessoas que acreditam na Educação e têm como valores primordiais o respeito ao próximo, foco em resultados, excelência e inovação.

Ao longo de 20 anos, temos feito a diferença na história de vida de muita gente através da nossa educação de qualidade, que vai desde o ensino infantil ao preparatório para vestibulares, do superior, pós-graduação ao preparatório para concursos, além da nossa editora educacional que está presente em todo o Brasil.

No Grupo Educacional CEV, ao compartilharmos conhecimento estamos construindo um legado que inova em todas as fases do aprendizado. Temos um time unido e movido por desafios em prol do nosso propósito: Transformar vidas através da educação.

Para nós, o saber vai além das salas de aula, integrando todos os aspectos do desenvolvimento humano, por essa razão, somos comprometidos em proporcionar experiências que preparam os alunos para os desafios do futuro.

Aqui, cultivamos o respeito ao próximo e a diversidade.

Nosso Compromisso Com a Excelência

Mantemos padrões elevados em todas as nossas marcas, afinal, nossa missão é oferecer soluções educacionais que transcendem o convencional, preparando os alunos para se destacarem em suas respectivas jornadas acadêmicas e profissionais.

Cultura De Respeito e Colaboração

Para nós, o respeito é a base de qualquer comunidade bem-sucedida. No Grupo, cada membro da equipe é valorizado. A colaboração é incentivada, pois acreditamos que juntos alcançamos resultados extraordinários.

Foco em resultados: Alcançando o sucesso juntos!

Ter foco em resultados significa mais do que simplesmente atingir metas, para nós, é superá-las de forma consistente. Por isso, aqui no Grupo, encorajamos o trabalho em equipe reconhecendo que juntos somos capazes de superar expectativas em todas as nossas frentes de atuação.

Um legado de inovação

A inovação está no DNA do Grupo CEV. Estamos constantemente explorando novas formas de ensino, aprendizado e desenvolvimento. Desde métodos pedagógicos de ponta até soluções tecnológicas avançadas. Estamos determinados a liderar o caminho na transformação digital da educação.
