Company Description

Syngenta is a global leader in agricultural innovation with a presence in more than 90 countries. Syngenta is focused on developing technologies and farming practices that empower farmers, so they can make the transformation required to feed the world’s population while preserving our planet. Its bold scientific discoveries deliver better benefits for farmers and society on a bigger scale than ever before. Guided by its Sustainability Priorities, Syngenta is developing new technologies and solutions that support farmers to grow healthier plants in healthier soil with a higher yield. Syngenta Crop Protection is headquartered in Basel, Switzerland; Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States. Read our stories and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram & X.

We make a difference

At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, Syngenta’s CPD is seeking for a Software Engineering Manager – AI.

Job Description

Location: São Paulo – BR

We are seeking a visionary AI Engineering Leader to fill the role of Software Engineering Manager, AI. In this role, you will be the technical catalyst for our AI transformation, driving the development of innovative products that leverage Machine Learning (ML), Generative AI, and Advanced Analytics. You will develop purposeful digital products that bridge the gap between complex supply chain data and actionable digital solutions. You will work closely with the Head of IT and Digital and the Vegetable Seeds Leadership team to execute a strategy that embeds AI into our global operations—from production and processing to quality and logistics. Profile: a technical leader with extensive experience in technology product architecture, implementation and operations, who can build and scale a robust data and AI offering to power Syngenta's AI-driven transformation.

The Ideal Candidate Will
  • AI Product Strategy: Develop and execute an engineering strategy focused on AI-driven products that align with global business objectives in Vegetable Seeds.
  • Full-Stack AI Delivery: Oversee the end-to-end development of AI applications, ensuring they meet rigorous technical requirements for reliability, security, and ethical AI standards.
  • Cross-Functional Synergy: Collaborate with AI Product Managers, Data Leads, and Global Data organization to ensure high-quality data pipelines and user-centric AI interfaces.
  • Global Scalability: Identify opportunities to deploy AI solutions across our 85 countries of operation, ensuring reusability of models and best practices.
  • Technical Mentorship: Provide guidance to a team of software engineers fostering a culture of AI literacy and continuous innovation.
  • Resource Optimization: Manage budgets and timelines for AI initiatives, navigating the unique resource requirements of GPU/Cloud compute and high-performance data processing.
  • Innovation Scouting: Stay at the forefront of emerging AI trends (e.g., Computer Vision for seed quality, RAG for internal knowledge management) to drive competitive advantage.
Qualifications Critical technical, professional and personal capabilities
  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/Machine Learning, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: 10+ years in product engineering, with at least 3-5 years specifically focused on AI/ML implementation at an enterprise scale.
  • AI Technical Depth: Hands-on experience with AI frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow), Cloud AI Services (Databricks/AWS), and modern software architecture.
  • Operational Mindset: Proven ability to apply AI to solve real-world supply chain, quality, or production problems in a global manufacturing or agricultural context.
  • Agile Leadership: Strong experience leading high-performing, distributed teams using Agile methodologies to deliver iterative AI value.
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex AI concepts into business-ready insights for non-technical stakeholders across the global organization.
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: A mindset focused on outcomes rather than just output, capable of delivering results in a fast-paced, global digital transformation environment.
Critical Leadership Capabilities
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to build and mentor high-performing technical teams
  • Strong vision for leveraging AI to drive business value and innovation
  • Skill in translating complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences
  • Change management experience in large organizations
  • Ability to build relationships across technical and business teams
  • Ability to align technology initiatives with organizational goals
Additional Information

We believe that the feeling of belonging allows people to become their best version, building an increasingly welcoming and productive environment. All qualified candidates will be considered for our positions, without distinction of race, gender, age, nationality or disability.

title: Gerente de Serviços - Sul do Pará
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

title: Pessoa Engenheira De Infraestrutura Especialista (Sre)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Responsabilidades e habilidades
  • Planejar, implantar e manter a infraestrutura necessária para o pipeline de dados, incluindo servidores, containers ou clusters (por exemplo, configuração de clusters Spark/Databricks, instâncias de banco de dados PostgreSQL, clusters MongoDB e brokers Kafka), seja em ambiente de nuvem ou on-premises, garantindo configurações adequadas de alta disponibilidade e redundância.
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para automação de deploy das aplicações e componentes de dados (serviços Java, notebooks Databricks, configurações de bancos), promovendo entregas constantes e confiáveis sem interrupção do serviço.
  • Implementar soluções de monitoramento, logging e alerta para todos os componentes da plataforma (uso de ferramentas como Prometheus/Grafana, ELK Stack ou equivalentes), garantindo observabilidade completa do sistema (métricas de performance, falhas, latências, utilização de recursos) e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Trabalhar junto aos engenheiros de dados e desenvolvedores para melhorar a confiabilidade das aplicações, revisando configurações, identificando pontos únicos de falha e implementando soluções de resiliência (como balanceamento de carga, retries automáticos, fallback).
  • Gerenciar a segurança e conformidade da infraestrutura, aplicando atualizações de sistema, patches de segurança, configurações de firewall e acessos apropriados, em alinhamento com políticas corporativas e requisitos (por exemplo, LGPD).
  • Otimizar a performance e custo da infraestrutura, monitorando uso de recursos e escalando ambientes conforme necessidade (vertical ou horizontalmente), bem como implementando rotinas de housekeeping (expurgo de logs, archiving de dados) para manter o ambiente saudável.
  • Liderar a resposta a incidentes críticos relacionados à infraestrutura ou disponibilidade dos sistemas de dados, investigando raiz de problemas (post‑mortem) e implementando ações preventivas para evitar recorrências.
  • Domínio de sistemas operacionais Linux e competências em automação de infraestrutura (shell scripting, Python) e infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares).
  • Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de containerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) para gerir serviços containerizados e escalar aplicações.
  • Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) ou com ambientes virtualizados on‑premises, compreendendo rede, armazenamento e computação, e habilidade para configurar serviços como bancos de dados gerenciados, balanceadores de carga, etc.
  • Prática em configurar e manter ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, etc.) e interpretar métricas para troubleshooting.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de SRE, incluindo definição de SLOs/SLAs, error budget, e experiência em protocolos de resposta a incidentes.

  • Provide adequate tools and methodology to the assets for influencing the operator on field management and development;

Participate in building and updating the affiliate's subsurface databases.

Requirements
  • Advanced English;
  • Background: Master in Reservoir / Petroleum Engineering;
  • Knowledge in pre‑salt reservoirs and context;
  • Previous experience (preferably with an operator of the O&G);
Technical Skills

Reservoir simulation software (Eclipse / IX). Reservoir interpretation software (PETEX suite, Kappa Saphir, OFM...), and subsurface databases.

title: Oracle Ebs Finance Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career! Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Oracle EBS Finance Functional Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

Responsibilities 1. Functional Expertise & Requirements

Analyze and validate financial business requirements related to data conversion from SAP to Oracle EBS.

Understand existing SAP Financial structures to design accurate mapping to Oracle EBS.

2. Data Conversion & Mapping

Lead functional activities for end‑to‑end data migration cycles (Extract–Transform–Load).

Define conversion mapping rules from SAP data elements to Oracle EBS financial objects.

Review data profiling results and identify gaps or anomalies.

Collaborate with technical teams to finalize conversion design documents (MD50 / MD70).

Validate converted data in Oracle EBS test environments.

Perform financial data reconciliations (trial balance, open transactions, subledger balances).

Support mock conversions, SIT, and UAT cycles.

4. Cross‑Functional Coordination

Work closely with SAP functional teams to understand data structures, dependencies, and transformation logic.

Partner with business users to confirm functional expectations and sign‑off on migrated data.

Collaborate with technical developers, DB teams, and cutover managers.

5. Cutover & Go‑Live Support

Prepare conversion runbooks and validation checklists.

Support cutover planning, execution, and post‑go‑live activities.

Troubleshoot issues related to financial data in Oracle EBS.

Mandatory Skills

Advanced English

Experience with EBS R12 upgrade & Implementation Oracle projects.

Prior experience in multi country / multi ledger implementations.

Ability to read and validate SQL queries (basic to intermediate level).

Experience reviewing MD50 / MD70 / ADI templates.

Familiarity with interface programs, APIs, and financial open transactions.

Proven experience in at least one large SAP → Oracle EBS migration or multi system financial conversion project.

Strong understanding of financial data flows, chart of accounts, ledger setups, subledger architectures, and accounting rules.

Experience as an Oracle EBS (R12) Finance Functional Consultant.

Strong knowledge of the following Oracle Financial modules:
  • General Ledger (GL)
  • Accounts Payable (AP)
  • Accounts Receivable (AR)
  • Fixed Assets (FA)
  • Cash Management (CM)

About Paysafe

Paysafe is a leading payments platform with an extensive track record of serving merchants and consumers in the global entertainment sectors. Its core purpose is to enable businesses and consumers to connect and transact seamlessly through industry-leading capabilities in payment processing, digital wallet, and online cash solutions. With 29 years of online payment experience, an annualized transactional volume of $152 billion in 2024, and approximately 3,000 employees located in 12+ countries, Paysafe connects businesses and consumers across 260 payment types in 48 currencies around the world. Delivered through an integrated platform, Paysafe solutions are geared toward mobile-initiated transactions, real-time analytics and the convergence between brick-and-mortar and online payments. Further information is available at

This role will be based in our office in Lima, and you will have the flexibility to split your time between the office and remote working.

Job Description
  • Lead on the setting on Paysafe’s regulatory positioning in LATAM to support the realization of Paysafe’s growth objectives in a sustainable and regulatory compliant manner through the provision of advice that reflects both Paysafe’s objectives and known/expected regulatory requirements/developments.
  • Position Paysafe as an industry leader in the influence of policy and law making by Governments and Regulatory bodies in the LATAM region through both direct engagement and through industry bodies.
  • Identify business opportunities arising from the strategic positioning of Paysafe within the relevant regulatory regimes in LATAM countries and advise on how best to achieve those.
  • Assess and communicate potential regulatory risk in a timely manner and lead on ensuring that the necessary mitigating actions are identified and implemented, particularly in respect of regulatory changes arising from both laws and regulatory expectations.
  • Collaborate with internal colleagues to identify and advise on optimum approaches to the enablement of business in a compliant and sustainable manner.
  • Manage Paysafe’s relationship with key regulators, ensuring that they properly understand Paysafe’s business model and products and are provided with any relevant information in a clear, accurate and timely manner.
  • Prepare and deliver periodic reporting on the LATAM regulatory environment to internal Committees and Boards.
  • Lead on all discussions relating to regulatory matters in LATAM in both internal and external fora.
Key Capabilities/Knowledge/Competencies
  • Qualified lawyer with 5 -7+ years' PQE
  • Financial services regulation experience gained in a financial institution, regulator or financial services department of a law firm with experience interacting with the regulatory authorities
  • Deep knowledge of Payments/E-Money industry experience required.
  • High self-motivation, positive ‘can-do’ attitude and collaborative approach and the ability to lead and provide direction to colleagues
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex legal issues to multi-disciplinary teams
Why work at Paysafe
  • Career Growth : We offer continuous learning and development opportunities, empowering you to nurture your career in the dynamic world of online payments.
  • Employee Benefits : In addition to a competitive salary, we offer health insurance, cancer and life insurance, 30 days of paid vacation, 4 paid volunteer days per year, summer hours (Dec-Mar), a birthday day off, and more.
  • Work-Life Balance : We are committed to fostering a balanced work environment with flexibility, ensuring you have the opportunity to thrive both personally and professionally.

Resource Manager, Professional Services

CAI Software, LLC • Salto, São Paulo, Brazil

Descrição da vaga

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real‑time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.

In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data‑driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user‑centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry‑specific business and production software technology for the print industry. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best‑in‑class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities Resource Planning and Allocation
  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real‑time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date skills and certifications records for all consultants.
Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross‑training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long‑term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.
Process Optimization and Tool Management
  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.
Daily Operational Responsibilities New Engagement Intake
  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.
Assignment & Scheduling
  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.
System Sync and Integration Oversight
  • Cross‑reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold‑to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalating issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.
Time Tracking Oversight
  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.
Project Health & Status Monitoring
  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.
Reporting & Communication
  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.
Performance and Collaboration
  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.
Qualifications Experience
  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written proficiency with English.
Skills
  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike).
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Product Manager - Finance Automation
description:
Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross‑border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture‑backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost‑effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting‑edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape.

Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world‑class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

We’re hiring an AI‑Native Product Manager who combines analytical rigor with a strong bias for action. This role will own the Finance Automation pillar, defining how global customers manage spend, automate expense workflows, and eliminate manual financial processes.

You will go deep into data and customer conversations to identify the highest‑impact problems, build a clear case for where to invest, and move quickly from insight to shipped product. This is not a strategy‑only role. While structured thinking and strong communication are essential, we’re looking for someone who can translate analysis into execution, creates prototypes as specs, partners with engineering and design, and iterates rapidly based on results.

You will lead the full product lifecycle, using AI not as a surface‑level feature, but as a foundational layer to redesign financial workflows from first principles—collapsing multi‑step, manual processes into seamless automated outcomes.

Because our customers operate across Latin America, the US, and Europe, we strongly prefer candidates based in Mexico, Colombia, or Brazil who understand the operational and market nuances of these regions.

Location

This role is based out of São Paulo, Brazil, and is a full‑time position where it is required to come into our office at complexo JK Iguatemi (2‑3 days/week). #LI‑Hybrid

What you will do AI‑Native Product Thinking
  • Start from the user’s pain, not from the technology. Identify workflows where finance professionals (accountants, controllers, treasurers, AP teams, CFOs) lose hours to manual work, and determine where AI can collapse multi‑step processes into zero‑effort outcomes. Evaluate AI capabilities with a clear‑eyed cost/benefit lens: understand latency tradeoffs, accuracy thresholds in financial data, hallucination risks, and the real cost of errors when a misclassified expense has downstream consequences for audits and reporting. Know when a well‑designed rules engine beats an LLM.
  • Personally prototype and evaluate AI‑powered approaches—test prompts, assess model outputs, build quick proof‑of‑concepts—to validate whether an AI solution actually works before pulling in engineering. We want someone who is hands‑on with AI tooling, not just managing an AI roadmap from a distance.
  • Partner closely with engineering to move from validated concept to production with speed and pragmatism. Ship AI‑powered features rapidly, with clear metrics for whether they’re actually improving user outcomes.
Insight & Analysis
  • Be the team’s expert on the customer: conduct regular customer discovery interviews, synthesize qualitative feedback across markets, and extract actionable insights that shape the product direction.
  • Define and track KPIs for adoption, engagement, and retention; build dashboards and analyses that diagnose problems, measure impact, and surface non‑obvious opportunities.
  • Triangulate quantitative data with qualitative signals—you don’t just report metrics, you investigate root causes, segment user behavior, and build the analytical case for where to invest next.
  • Run structured experiments (learn‑test‑measure) to validate hypotheses before committing engineering resources.
  • Lean into the latest AI‑enabled analytics capabilities to accelerate your own insight generation—using AI as a tool in your own workflow, not just a feature you ship to customers.
Strategy & Vision
  • Define and own the product strategy for Finance Automation, developing a clear, defensible point of view on where the market is heading and how Jeeves wins. Deep understanding of competitive dynamics, and business impact—structured with the rigor of a top‑tier strategy framework.
  • Identify new market opportunities and potential risks by staying deeply informed on industry trends, competitive moves, and emerging technologies in fintech and spend management.
Execution & Delivery
  • Lead with creating AI‑enabled prototypes backed by customer insights. Drive continuous product development: write clear specs, scope work tightly, and ship and iterate rapidly with engineering, design, and cross‑functional partners.
  • Own outcomes end‑to‑end—you are accountable for the success of your product area, removing blockers and driving forward even when the path is ambiguous.
  • Move between the analytical and the tactical fluidly: in the same day, you might be deep in a data analysis, running a customer interview, writing a PRD, and reviewing designs pixel by pixel.
  • Sweat the details: consider every edge case, every user flow, and every pixel. Maintain an uncompromising bar for quality in everything that ships.
Communication & Stakeholder Management
  • Communicate product strategy, progress, and decisions with clarity and precision—translating complex trade‑offs into narratives that align leadership, engineering, sales, and operations.
  • Produce structured, high‑quality written artifacts (strategy docs, business cases, post‑mortems) that drive alignment and enable faster decision‑making.
  • Maintain open, proactive communication channels across Jeeves stakeholders; ensure the broader organization is informed, aligned, and bought in.
What we are looking for
  • 3+ years of management consulting at a top‑tier firm (e.g., Bain, BCG, McKinsey) or product management experience in fintech, B2B SaaS with complex workflows, or multi‑market operations. The combination of strategic rigor from consulting and hands‑on product building experience is the ideal profile.
  • Language ability (written and spoken): Fluency in English and Spanish or Portuguese required, trilingual a plus!
  • Exceptional analytical skills: you are comfortable building models, writing SQL, digging into large datasets, and translating numbers into clear business narratives. You form your own views from data, not just summaries from others. Leveraging AI to accelerate your own analysis is expected, not optional.
  • Strong qualitative research instincts: you know how to run effective customer interviews, synthesize themes across conversations, and turn insights into product decisions.
  • Proven builder: a solid track record of shipping and iterating on successful products. You don’t just plan—you deliver, learn, and improve.
  • Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal. You can write a crisp strategy memo, present to executives, and rally a cross‑functional team around a shared vision.
  • Hands‑on comfort with AI tooling: you can personally test prompts, evaluate model outputs, and build quick prototypes to assess feasibility. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you need to get your hands dirty with the technology, not just discuss it in meetings.
  • Based in Latin America, preferably in Mexico, Colombia, or Brazil. Willingness to work across global time zones, including up to 10% travel.

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

  • the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  • the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.
  • efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions project, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Oversee the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
    • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
    • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
    • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
    • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required;
    • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
    • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
    • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
    • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
YOUR PROFILE
  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Atuar com práticas DevOps, incluindo manutenção e monitoramento de ambientes de produção.

Requisitos e Qualificações Obrigatórios :
  • de 8 anos de experiência com C# e .NET Framework / Core;

  • Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (ex : Datadog, Dynatrace);
  • Conhecimento em microserviços (comunicação síncrona / assíncrona, Saga Pattern);

Forte compreensão de arquiteturas de alta escala e performance.

O que não combina com a gente 1. Resistência ao ritmo acelerado e à pressão

A Mottu tem uma cultura de alta performance, com foco em velocidade, entrega e resultado. O ambiente é intenso e muda rápido.

Quem não tem resiliência ou precisa de acompanhamento constante tende a ter dificuldade.

Aqui, não há espaço para zona de conforto ou microgestão.

2. Falta de proatividade e aversão à “mão na graxa”

Valorizamos quem vai até a raiz do problema, entra na operação e resolve .

Esperar que outros tomem a frente, evitar tarefas operacionais ou depender de supervisão constante não combina com nossa cultura.

Quem não coloca a mão na massa dificilmente entende o que precisa ser melhorado — e não evolui aqui.

E quando falamos de “mão na graxa”, é literal : vamos para a oficina, atuamos com o time e executamos funções operacionais .

Essa vivência prática traz insights que seriam impossíveis à distância.

3. Baixo espírito de dono e pouca autonomia

Esperamos atitude de dono: coragem para decidir, assumir riscos e gerar impacto real.

Quem espera ser “mandado” ou depende de validação constante tende a ficar para trás.

Aqui, protagonismo não é opcional — é parte do trabalho.

E diferente de muitas empresas, levamos isso a sério: quem entrega com consistência e atitude é reconhecido, recebe espaço e pode até se tornar sócio.

Stock options não são exceção — são consequência.

4. Falta de abertura para feedback e pouca maturidade emocional

Somos uma cultura de transparência direta . Feedbacks são frequentes, sinceros — e nem sempre suaves.

É preciso humildade e maturidade para encarar conversas difíceis, sem ego ou melindres.

Quem evita confronto construtivo ou não aceita críticas com boa intenção pode se sentir deslocado.

5. ⏰ Apego rígido ao horário comercial

A Mottu ainda é uma startup em crescimento acelerado . Os desafios mudam rápido, e as demandas nem sempre respeitam o relógio.

Não há certo ou errado — o que importa é resolver o problema .

Se você busca rotina estável e separação rígida entre vida pessoal e trabalho, pode se frustrar aqui.

Entregar com qualidade é o foco — e isso nem sempre cabe dentro do horário comercial.

6. Falta de comprometimento e troca frequente de trabalho

Aqui, não buscamos apenas talento — buscamos gente que queira construir junto .

Se a cada desafio ou obstáculo a primeira reação é procurar a próxima oportunidade, dificilmente haverá tempo para gerar impacto real.

A Mottu é feita para quem tem visão de longo prazo, veste a camisa e está disposto a atravessar ciclos inteiros de crescimento, mostrar seu espaço e se tornar sócio.

Quem não se compromete, não colhe os frutos — e aqui, eles são grandes para quem fica e faz acontecer.

Se você se identifica com esse ritmo, essa cultura e quer fazer parte de um time que realmente constrói tecnologia de impacto: vem com a gente.

title: Finance Director
description:
Full Time Executive Finance Director in financial services at Hogarth in Sao Paulo, Brazil. Apply directly through the link below.

What skills are required? Performance Management, Problem Solving, Infrastructure, Forecasting, Leadership, Innovation, Compliance, Accounting, Budgeting, Feedback, and more.

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

WPP Production is part of WPP. WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients, and communities. Formore information, visitwpp.com

What does a Finance Director do at WPP Production?

The Finance Director will help lead all finance forecasting, revenue reports, invoicing, and cross team collaborations. Will be responsible for enhancing financial processes, systems, and infrastructure that will allow the operation to continue to grow and meet it’s financial goals.

Key Areas of Responsibility
  • Provide quarterly and monthly forecast updates for Fee and Studio revenue.
  • Track SOWs, revenue files and maintain audit back up.
  • Report monthly Revenue Recognition.
  • Advise on month-to-month changes in fees and costs managing revenue samples for audits.
  • Provide margin analysis impact based on revenue/cost changes.
  • Work with Talent/HR on open position reports and staffing reports approving freelance hires and track freelance budget.
  • Collaborate with other WPP agencies and teams on cross business billing and projects.
  • Work with client teams on fee pricing based on client commercial terms.
  • Open billable projects and generate estimates reviewing monthly billing for fee projects.
  • Approve PO’s and vendor invoices and the intercompany invoices.
  • Supervise studio billing manager, and oversee business policies, compliance, and accounting practices.
  • Responsible for Brazilian Balance Sheet, budgets and financial planning and analysis.
  • Lead rate negotiations and evaluations.
  • Lead and support the organizational budgeting process.
  • Review, enhance and implement new systems and processes that support a growing business model, including time reporting, estimating, and financial management tools.
  • Present relevant financial data to our parent company, WPP.
  • Ensure client financial activities are consistent, profitable, and meet client and Hogarth objectives.
  • Oversee the development and negotiation of client contracts and agreements including MSAs, KPIs, and SLAs in collaboration with account management.
  • Support and advise leadership and management teams in decision making.
  • Oversee risk management and legal activities: letters of agreement, contracts, leases, and other legal documents and agreements.
  • Contribute to resource and staff planning.
  • Establish and manage relationships with senior agency partners within WPP and with clients.
Reporting lines and key stakeholders

This role reports to the Global CFO.

You will work closely with all company teams.

Requirements Technical Skills
  • English: Fluent.
  • Experience in business management, finance, planning, and staff management.
  • Understanding of Production rate cards.
  • Understanding of offshoring process, global company relations and parent company interactions.
  • Successfully lead SOX compliance initiatives.
  • Good-to-have: Experience within the production, advertising, marketing, media or like industry.
  • Good-to-have: FP&A experience.
Soft Skills
  • Show excellent ability to manage multiple tasks with transparency and accountability.
  • Be proactive, organized and, mainly, committed to deadlines and deliverance of projects.
  • Customer Focus, Collaboration and Team Working.
  • Negotiation Skill.
  • Continuous Improvement and Inspire Others.
  • Problem Solving, Tactical Thinking, Delegation and Conflict Management.
  • Emotional Intelligence, Empathy.
  • Strategic Vision and Systemic View.
  • Feedback, Time, Processes and Performance Management.
  • Excellent inter-company relationship management skills.
  • Strong communication abilities.

#LI-RP1

Why work here

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data

We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

title: Gerente de Compliance e Regulatório
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Pagaleve é uma empresa do setor de “Buy Now Pay Later”. Somos uma das primeiras empresas a oferecer pagamento parcelado no PIX, sem juros, e sem a necessidade de usar cartão de crédito. Temos como objetivo oferecer aos lojistas um novo método de pagamento, para aumentar suas vendas de um jeito simples, descomplicado e ágil, mas também temos como objetivo oferecer às pessoas a oportunidade de comprar aquilo que desejam, sem se comprometerem com os altos juros do cartão de crédito.

A Pagaleve foi fundada em 2021 e já conta com uma trajetória acelerada de crescimento, e conta, entre os investidores, fundos como Our Innovation Fund, da Austrália, Founder Collective, dos Estados Unidos, e Entrée Capital.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Essa pessoa será responsável por liderar e estruturar a agenda de Compliance Regulatório e a interface com o Banco Central do Brasil (BCB), garantindo governança normativa, execução de reportes regulatórios e sustentação do crescimento do negócio como Instituição de Pagamento (IP) pós-paga e, quando aplicável, em iniciativas relacionadas a ITP/Open Finance.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Estruturar e operar os fluxos e processos de reporte ao Bacen, garantindo governança, evidências, controles e trilha de auditoria;
  • Construir e manter o calendário regulatório, coordenando áreas envolvidas e garantindo entregas dentro do prazo e com qualidade;
  • Ser ponto focal interno para obrigações regulatórias aplicáveis à IP (incluindo rotinas recorrentes e demandas específicas do BCB), assegurando consistência das informações submetidas;
  • Implementar controles e validações de qualidade (completude, acurácia, consistência e tempestividade), com KPIs e SLAs do processo;
  • Monitorar mudanças regulatórias (BCB/CMN) e liderar a implementação de ajustes em processos, políticas e procedimentos;
  • Gerir o arcabouço normativo interno: elaboração, revisão e atualização de políticas, procedimentos e manuais;
  • Estruturar e coordenar comitês de assessment de produtos e mapeamento regulatório, apoiando decisões e garantindo documentação de riscos;
  • Atuar de forma transversal com Produto e Tech para integrar requisitos regulatórios ao desenvolvimento e à operação (incluindo, quando aplicável, frentes de ITP/Open Finance);
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver o time, promovendo previsibilidade, melhoria contínua e cultura de compliance.
Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduação em Direito, com OAB ativa;
  • Pós-graduação (especialização/MBA) será considerada um diferencial.

Experiência :

  • Experiência mandatória em Fintechs por, no mínimo, 4 anos (preferencialmente meios de pagamento, IP pós-paga e/ou ITP/Open Finance);
  • Experiência sólida com regulatório Bacen, incluindo interpretação, revisão e implementação de normativos e avaliação de impacto;
  • Vivência na construção de fluxos e processos de reporte ao Bacen, incluindo organização de evidências e trilha de auditoria.

Sistemas do Bacen (mandatório - hands on):

title: Flebotomista - Gaspar
description:
Descrição da vaga

Se o seu propósito é inspirar pessoas a cuidar de pessoas, você está no lugar certo!

Fundado em Brasília pelas bioquímicas Janete Vaz e Sandra Soares Costa, o Grupo Sabin está há 38 anos no mercado. Nos tornamos um grupo de referência em Medicina Diagnóstica, com mais de 7.300 serviços de saúde, desde análises clínicas, diagnósticos por imagem, vacinação e check‑up executivo. O Sabin também atua em Atenção Primária à Saúde (APS), com a Amparo Saúde, e lançou no ano passado, a plataforma integradora de serviços de saúde, Rita Saúde.

Somos reconhecidos no Brasil e América Latina, como uma das Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar por mais de 18 anos consecutivos. Partimos de uma cultura organizacional forte em um ambiente de respeito, desenvolvimento, diversidade e inclusão. Temos mais de 7.000 colaboradores e estamos presentes em 15 estados e no Distrito Federal em 350 unidades distribuídas de norte a sul do país.

Quer conhecer mais sobre a nossa marca? Então acesse ou ainda em nossas redes oficiais: Linkedin Sabin Medicina Diagnóstica | Instagram @sabinmedicinadiagnostica | Facebook Sabin Medicina Diagnóstica |

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Atender aos clientes com humanização;
  • Realizar coleta e triagem de materiais para realização de exames laboratoriais;
  • Realizar etapas do processo analítico, controle interno de qualidade, inspeções e checagem das amostras;
  • Centrifugar amostras biológicas e manipular equipamentos laboratoriais;
  • Acondicionar material biológico para transporte;
  • Anotar no sistema informatizado os resultados das análises e testes procedidos;
  • Repor o material e conservar sempre arrumado o box de coleta;
  • Atender a todos os clientes internos e externos com cordialidade, respeito e eficiência;
  • Participar de 100% dos treinamentos em que for convocado pela organização;
  • Executar demais atividades pertinentes ao cargo;
  • Zelar pelo sigilo e segurança das informações respeitando as normas e políticas de segurança da informação e proteção de dados.
Requisitos e qualificações

Formação mínima: Curso Técnico em Laboratório, Técnico em Análises Clínicas, Patologia Clínica, Técnicos de Enfermagem, Enfermagem.

Informações adicionais

Horário da vaga: 44h semanais - Segunda a Sábado.

Benefícios:

  • Benefícios pensados para o seu dia a dia: Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível, Vale Alimentação ou Refeição;
  • Benefícios para a sua Saúde e Bem-Estar: Plano de Saúde e Odontológico, Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida e Seguro de Vida;
  • Festividades: Auxílio Noel e Meio dia de folga de aniversário;
  • Clube de vantagens: Descontos em estudos, produtos e diversão;
  • Benefícios para a família: Eu cuido dos meus pais;
  • Dentre outros benefícios.

*Os benefícios podem sofrer alterações.*

Descrição de como será o processo seletivo:

Analisamos todos os perfis com muita atenção, cuidado e consideração. Entraremos em contato com os candidatos mais aderentes ao perfil da vaga.

Recebemos um volume considerável de candidaturas, e por esta razão, pode ser que você não seja convocado de imediato para a sua vaga desejada.

Toda comunicação do nosso processo é feita via e-mail. Por isso, fique atenta(o) a sua caixa de entrada e spam. Caso tenha alguma dúvida ou problema com alguma de nossas etapas, nos sinalize ou fale com o suporte de atendimento da plataforma clicando no chat que fica no canto inferior direito da página do Portal do Candidato.

Ficamos felizes com o seu interesse em compor o nosso time!

Esperamos te encontrar em breve!

Requisitos

Responsabilidades
  • Operar equipamentos conforme normas NR, garantindo uso correto de EPI.
  • Cumprir as políticas de HSE, Qualidade e Inventário.
  • Preencher checklists, realizar trocas de bateria e zelar pela conservação dos equipamentos e estrutura.
  • Executar processos de recebimento, armazenamento, separação e expedição, assegurando atualização no sistema de gerenciamento de armazém (RF) e WMS (Warehouse management system).

  • Apoiar inventários e contagens cíclicas, conferindo produtos e registrando informações no sistema.
  • Movimentar e controlar materiais pendentes, devoluções e desvios conforme orientação da liderança.
  • Emitir relatórios internos, de produtividade e para clientes, garantindo prazos e acuracidade.
  • Reportar movimentações de saldo, ocorrências e pendências à liderança e confirmar conclusões via e‑mail para evidência sistêmica.
  • Abrir e consolidar relatórios de não conformidade (NQ), comunicando cliente e time de inventário.
  • Prestar suporte em processos críticos (puxada, picking, reversa) e atendimentos emergenciais.
  • Garantir limpeza e organização do local de trabalho conforme práticas de 5S.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos, seguindo orientações da liderança.
Benefícios
  • Assistência Médica (Enfermaria, isento de mensalidade e extensivo aos dependentes)

  • Seguro de Vida
  • Gympass (Rede credenciada de diversas academias)
  • Clube de descontos (Descontos promocionais em diversas categorias)
Sobre a DHL

A DHL Supply Chain é líder global em logística, conectando pessoas e negócios. Com soluções inovadoras e operações eficientes, valorizamos cada pessoa e acreditamos na força da diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente seguro, inclusivo e colaborativo, onde cada talento pode se desenvolver e construir uma carreira com propósito. Clique aqui para saber mais!
